author: @fl0rianr

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. HTTP 4xx/5xx status-code errors retain their original error message format. The new retryable reset behavior is an internal control flow change — the client-facing SSE stream interface is unchanged, and the error response format for cancellations remains the same.
evidence.documentation: Not affected. No API surface, CLI flag, or config default changed. The author checked 'Documentation is not affected' which is correct.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This commit changes user-visible behavior: when the Trellis 3D backend process dies or drops the connection during a generation, the server now throws a BackendStreamRetryableReset that triggers a watchdog reset and stream retry, whereas previously the uncaught transport error could leave the stream in a broken state. This is a real surface a tester can exercise via the 3D generation endpoint.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Zero. The PR contained a single commit (f32156c) which was the approved commit. No post-approval churn.
evidence.review: @pwilkin — a maintainer whose subject area includes Trellis — approved the PR at 2026-11-28T11:22:15Z, just one second before the merge commit. The review decision is APPROVED with no inline comments. CodeRabbit posted a COMMENTED review noting PR body inconsistencies (redundant sentence, claim about improved error reporting not matched by the diff) but flagged no substantive code issues. No other human reviewers participated.
evidence.security: No concerns. The code uses HttpSecurityPolicy::TrustedLoopback (unchanged). The added include <curl/curl.h> is already transitively included elsewhere. No credential, network, or permission changes.
evidence.tests: No automated tests for the Trellis backend were found in the repository. The author reports local testing ('Trellis 3D still works fine and correct report'). The diff changes error-handling control flow (removing an inline transport-error check and replacing it with exception handlers), which is difficult to cover with unit tests without mocking the HTTP client. No test weakening or deletion.

maintainer_todos.text: Start the server with the Trellis 3D backend loaded, submit a 3D generation request with an image, and then stop or crash the trellis process mid-stream; confirm the SSE stream returns a retryable reset error that a client can catch and re-submit.

subject: fix(trellis): correct HTTP error handling and watchdog retrial (#3935)
summary: Fixes the Trellis 3D generation endpoint to catch CURL transport-level errors (previously silently ignored) and triggers a watchdog-based automatic backend reset and stream retry when the Trellis process disconnects.
verdict_reason: The change alters how the Trellis 3D generation endpoint responds when the backend disconnects — clients receive a retryable reset error instead of a generic failure — but no human exercised this behavior before merge.
